update_cadence: monthly (Future Partners, Longwoods waves) / annual (Deloitte, MMGY)
prior_evidence: Deloitte 2025 holiday survey: high-income trips 2.5 -> 1.9, budgets -18%; Future Partners Jan 2026: outlook more subdued than Jan 2025
value_tier: B: early read on the holiday season; manual

name: US Travel Association / Tourism Economics travel forecast
mechanism: Annual and semi-annual forecasts of domestic and international travel spend
prior_evidence: UNVERIFIED (not opened this pass)
value_tier: C

name: Texas / Oklahoma / Kansas regional economic conditions (Dallas Fed Texas Business Outlook, energy survey)
mechanism: Texas is a key fly/drive origin; Texas oil-patch income is cyclical
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

name: Credit-card spending on travel (Bank of America Institute, Visa, Chase consumer data reports)
mechanism: Near-real-time travel spend by income cohort
prior_evidence: UNVERIFIED (not opened)
value_tier: C

name: USD exchange rates vs MXN, CAD, GBP, AUD, BRL, EUR
provider: Federal Reserve H.10 via FRED (DEXMXUS etc.)
mechanism: A strong dollar makes US ski trips dearer for foreign guests; NSAA and Vail attributed international declines to the strong dollar in 2014-16
data_quality_risk: international share small (~3-6% of US skier visits)
prior_evidence: NSAA 2014-15: international 6% of visits (STALE); Vail Resorts 2015-16 cited strong dollar for international decline (STALE)
value_tier: C for Winter Park (low international share); B for Vail/Aspen

name: NTTO I-94 / ADIS international arrivals by country (monthly)
mechanism: Realized inbound travel from Mexico, Canada, UK, Brazil, Australia; shows policy and sentiment shocks
granularity: country x month (port detail in monitors)
prior_evidence: NTTO Jan 2026: 5,412,343 arrivals -3.5% YoY; May 2026 Mexico +21%, overseas -6.5% (via inboundtravel.org)
value_tier: C: national; Winter Park international share small

name: Statistics Canada traveller return trips from US (air and auto)
mechanism: Canadian boycott/tariff sentiment cut US trips for 15 straight months to Mar 2026; Canadian ski travel to Colorado is mostly by air
prior_evidence: CTV/BNN 2026: Mar 2026 trips -6.4% YoY, air -10.8%; DestiMetrics: Canada cancellations rose Jul 2026
value_tier: C

name: US State Department travel advisories (outbound) and visa/ESTA policy changes
provider: US Dept of State Consular Affairs
mechanism: Advisories against outbound destinations (Mexico resorts, Europe) can redirect US ski/vacation spend domestically; inbound visa rules (fees, social-media vetting) deter foreign visitors
access: JSON API reported at cadataapi.state.gov (Cloudflare blocked curl: UNVERIFIED)
prior_evidence: none for lodging
value_tier: C

name: Tariff and trade-policy shock index (e.g. Baker-Bloom-Davis Economic Policy Uncertainty, trade policy uncertainty)
mechanism: Policy uncertainty depresses consumer and corporate discretionary spending; 2025-26 tariff episodes cut Canadian bookings
prior_evidence: Baker, Bloom & Davis 2016 QJE 131(4):1593-1636 (EPU construction)
value_tier: C: regime/scenario input

name: Conflict / oil-supply shock monitor (GDELT event counts, Brent spikes)
mechanism: Wars affecting oil and airfares hit travel costs and sentiment; acts through E04/E07 and M01. 2026 path was not one shock: Hormuz effectively closed from 2026-02-28; US-Iran MOU 2026-06-18 reopened it and the July STEO cut 2026 Brent 14% (MarketScale); constraints returned (Aug STEO); attacks on Saudi East-West pipeline lifted September Brent to $114 avg, peak $131 on 9/15; Oct 6 STEO: flows constrained through 4Q26, 4Q26 $105, 2027 $84. Treat oil as volatile and mean-reverting, not a season state
prior_evidence: none for lodging
value_tier: C: operator asked for geopolitics; value only via oil and sentiment

name: Federal shutdown / federal-employee furlough and national-park closures
mechanism: Shutdowns reduce federal-employee travel (Denver has a large federal workforce) and close Rocky Mountain NP (Grand Lake side of Grand County) in summer
prior_evidence: UNVERIFIED effect on Grand County
value_tier: C

name: Mexico SEP school calendar (winter break, Semana Santa) and peso
mechanism: Mexican families ski Colorado over Christmas-New Year and Semana Santa; 2026-27 Semana Santa is Mar 22-Apr 2, 2027, inside ski season
data_quality_risk: Mexico share of Winter Park unknown
prior_evidence: SEP 2026-27 calendar published in DOF 2026-07-15 (unotv, infobae); NTTO May 2026 Mexico arrivals +21%
value_tier: B: exact dates and a demand window generic pricers do not model, but Mexico's share of Winter Park demand is unknown, so value is uncertain

name: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (monthly forward forecast of retail gasoline, crude, jet fuel)
mechanism: A dated official forecast of pump prices for the coming months, i.e. the expected cost of the winter drive trip when holiday prices are set in autumn
data_quality_risk: forecast error large in war regimes
prior_evidence: EIA Oct 2026 STEO: Brent averaged $114/b in Sept 2026; Middle East flows assumed constrained through 4Q26
value_tier: B: forward version of E01 with archived vintages

name: CPI airline fares and CPI lodging away from home (BLS via FRED)
mechanism: Airfare inflation is the fly-in cost shock that jet fuel causes; lodging CPI is the guest's reference price trend
access: free FRED CSV VERIFIED 2026-10-16 (Sep 2026 airfare index 326.991)
prior_evidence: none for Winter Park
value_tier: C

name: Front Range school calendars (Denver PS, Jeffco, Cherry Creek, Douglas, Boulder Valley, Poudre, Colorado Springs D11/D20)
mechanism: Winter break and spring break weeks set when families can travel; Colorado districts often break in mid/late March
data_quality_risk: third-party aggregators disagree on DPS 2027 spring break (Mar 22-26 vs Mar 29-Apr 2); use official ICS only
prior_evidence: Dossier 03: Foley (Inntopia) attributed a soft March to Easter falling after closing
value_tier: A: exact, free, and the 2-3 strongest demand windows depend on it

name: Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Nebraska, Midwest district spring breaks (Dallas, Houston, Austin, Fort Worth, OKC, Tulsa, Wichita, Omaha, KC, Chicago)
mechanism: Fly/drive-in families come in their own spring-break weeks (Texas mostly mid-March: Dallas/Austin Mar 15-19, Houston Mar 8-12, 2027 per aggregators)
prior_evidence: Dossier 01 origin data: Chicago +84.6%, KC +66.9% DMO sessions 2024
value_tier: A: spring-break week mix decides March pricing

name: University spring breaks (CU Boulder, CSU, DU, UT Austin, Texas A&M, KU, K-State, Nebraska, Oklahoma)
mechanism: College groups rent large homes for spring break
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: B: fits 16-guest homes; check house rules

name: Federal holidays and holiday-weekday positions (MLK, Presidents Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas/New Year day-of-week)
mechanism: Long weekends compress demand; Christmas falling midweek vs weekend changes stay patterns and min-stay value
prior_evidence: PriceLabs min-stay docs treat holidays as demand events (vendor)
value_tier: A: deterministic and large value on the highest-priced nights (tier = value of information); no edge on its own because every pricer has it - edge comes only in interaction with C01/C02

name: Easter date and Western Christian/Orthodox Easter
mechanism: Easter inside vs after the ski season moves spring-break demand; 2027 Easter is March 28
prior_evidence: Foley (Inntopia, via Steamboat Pilot 2025): soft March because Easter fell after closing
value_tier: A (with C01/C02)

name: Jewish holidays (Hanukkah overlap with Christmas week, Passover)
mechanism: Holiday weeks for Jewish families from Front Range, Texas, Midwest, Northeast; Passover can overlap spring break
access: free REST, no key, CC-BY 4.0, 90 req/10 s (per Hebcal docs; WebFetch hit session limit)
prior_evidence: none for lodging
value_tier: C: small marginal effect

name: Ikon Pass blackout dates (Winter Park on Ikon Base) and Mountain Collective/other pass rules
mechanism: Winter Park is unlimited on Ikon Base with blackouts Dec 26-30 2026, Jan 16-17 and Feb 13-14 2027 (ikonpass.com, FETCHED); Base holders cannot ski those peak days
prior_evidence: docs/resort/WINTER_PARK_KNOWLEDGE.md
value_tier: B: deterministic; small effect for renters who often buy full passes

name: Winter Park hosted events (Winter Park Resort events, competitions, Mary Jane bumps, summer concerts, Tour de Winter Park, Fraser Valley events)
provider: Winter Park Resort / Chamber / Grand County events calendars
mechanism: Event weekends lift demand; competitions bring teams and families who need large homes
prior_evidence: 2027 FIS moguls dates Jan 15-16 / 22-23 (allsportdb; venue UNVERIFIED)
value_tier: B: local knowledge generic pricers lack

name: Denver conventions and big events (Colorado Convention Center, NWSS stock show January, concerts at Red Rocks, playoffs)
mechanism: Attendees add mountain extensions; large events tighten DEN airfares and Denver hotels
prior_evidence: denverconvention.com 2027 listings (HFMA Jun 27-30, 2027, 4,000+)
value_tier: C

name: Weddings and private events at Grand County venues (Devil's Thumb Ranch, Grand Lake, Winter Park venues)
mechanism: Weddings fill large homes for wedding parties, mostly summer/fall weekends
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C: summer; mostly owner-direct inquiries

name: Winter Park opening and closing dates; Mary Jane closing date
mechanism: Closing date defines when ski demand ends; early Mary Jane closure (Mar 27, 2026) cuts late-season value
prior_evidence: Denver Gazette 2026: Mary Jane closed 7 weeks earlier than prior year (UNVERIFIED exact)
value_tier: A: sets the season boundary for the ceiling

name: Lift and trail status, terrain %, lifts on hold (live feed)
mechanism: Terrain open % and lift holds proxy ski quality and crowding; slow early terrain lowers holiday WTP
licence_tos: unofficial feed; may change without notice
prior_evidence: Parthum & Christensen 2022 (snow depth as quality); resort ops priors in repo
value_tier: A: live, free, already ingested

name: Lift ticket window price and dynamic ticket pricing
mechanism: The resort's own dynamic ticket price is its demand forecast for each day
access: scrape; resort store returned 403; OnTheSnow publishes Winter Park day prices (adult $272 weekday / $282 weekend online pre-purchase, page updated 2025-10-03) and states prices are dynamic by date and purchase lead (VERIFIED 2026-10-17)
prior_evidence: OnTheSnow Winter Park lift-ticket page: dynamic by time of year and advance purchase
value_tier: B: a free forward demand forecast by date

name: Pass sales disclosures (Vail Resorts Epic pass units/dollars; Alterra Ikon statements)
mechanism: Season-pass sales through December show committed skier demand for the coming winter (pass holders still need lodging)
data_quality_risk: Vail data is Epic, not Ikon; Alterra private
prior_evidence: Vail 8-K (SEC, Sept 2026, FETCHED): 2026/27 pass units -12%, days -10%, dollars -6% through 2026-09-18; weakness concentrated in Destination (fly-in) frequency products; Colorado/Utah local markets modestly improved. Dec 2025 release: units -2%, declines in CO/UT/Tahoe local drive-to markets
value_tier: B: the most informative public season-ahead read this year, but company-wide Epic (not Ikon/Alterra), quarterly, and a prior rather than a nightly signal

name: NSAA skier visits (national and Rocky Mountain region); Kottke end-of-season report
mechanism: Season visit totals and region share calibrate season strength
prior_evidence: NSAA 2025-26 preliminary 52.6M visits vs 61.5M in 2024-25, about -14.5% (Storm Skiing; SAM); Rocky Mountain region about -24% per a forum post quoting NSAA (UNVERIFIED)
value_tier: C live / B backtest

name: Colorado Ski Country USA skier visits and statements
mechanism: Colorado member-resort visits (Winter Park is a member; Vail Resorts' are not). 2025-26 estimate about 10.5M (CSCUSA projected preliminary); a 3.3M drop (about -24%) and 'lowest since 1991-92' are from press coverage of the 2026-06-04 CSCUSA meeting (Post Independent), not the CSCUSA page
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

name: Resort staffing/hiring and labor shortages (job postings)
mechanism: Short staffing limits lifts and restaurants; affects early-season terrain
prior_evidence: repo knowledge doc (season-readiness prior)
value_tier: C

name: Snowmaking coverage and early-season terrain plan
mechanism: Determines Thanksgiving/early-December quality independent of natural snow
prior_evidence: Gonseth 2013 Climatic Change 119: snowmaking lowers snow sensitivity
value_tier: C

name: Town of Winter Park STR licences, caps and fees
mechanism: Licence counts lead listing supply by 6-12 months; caps raise the value of licensed homes
prior_evidence: PriceLabs ski-regulation note: regulated ski markets saw 27-38% supply cuts and Dec-Feb ADR +11-17% (vendor)
value_tier: B: slow but structural

name: Town of Fraser STR registration (Ordinances 488, 516)
mechanism: Registration/fees and fire inspections (Ord. 516, from Feb 2025) raise cost of operating, may shrink casual supply; no cap found
prior_evidence: Fraser Ord. 488 (2022) and 516 (2024) (frasercolorado.com DocumentCenter)
value_tier: C

name: Grand County unincorporated STR permits (annual, occupancy cap 16)
mechanism: Permit counts and occupancy caps limit large-home competitors; 16-guest cap matches our homes
data_quality_risk: occupancy cap figure from a PM blog (SkyRun), verify with county
prior_evidence: SkyRun blog (secondary)
value_tier: B: tells us how many 14-16 guest competitors can legally exist

name: Lodging tax rates and monthly lodging-tax collections (Winter Park, Fraser, Grand County; CO DOR county sales)
mechanism: Collections are the realized market revenue series for backtests (H5); rate changes (Winter Park 1% -> 3% Jul 2024) must be adjusted
access: PDF/manual; WP lodging returns by email request
prior_evidence: Dossier 03: Dec 2024 WP lodging -7% ex-rate-change; skyhinews 2024 rate change
value_tier: A for H5 and backtests (outcome series), not a live lead

name: HOA rules and covenants restricting STR in subdivisions
mechanism: Subdivision bans remove comps; also a risk to our own homes
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

name: Insurance and property-tax cost trends (Colorado wildfire insurance, SB22-238 property tax)
mechanism: Raises owner cost floor; affects owner-net, not demand
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C: floor input for owner-net

name: State STR tax and classification legislation (e.g. SB24-033 lodging reclassification)
mechanism: SB24-033 proposed reclassifying STRs rented over 90 days/yr as lodging property (27.9% vs 6.765% assessment, 2023 rates) from 2026; after Airbnb/VRBO opposition the sponsor proposed replacing it with a study (Vail Daily 2024-04-11); reintroduction would raise owner cost and shrink supply
prior_evidence: Vail Daily 2024-04-11 (final outcome of amendments not confirmed in that article)
value_tier: C

name: Substitute-resort snow and terrain (Breckenridge, Keystone, Copper, Vail, Steamboat, Arapahoe Basin)
mechanism: Relative snow matters: better snow at nearby resorts pulls skiers away; Parthum & Christensen control for snowpack at resorts within 100 km
prior_evidence: Gonseth 2013 Climatic Change 119: better snow at lower areas reduces visits at higher ones; Parthum & Christensen 2022 control for snowpack at resorts within 100 km; HVS 2015 (STALE): snow matters more at drive-to resorts, which is the substitution margin for Front Range skiers
value_tier: A: relative quality is what generic pricers ignore

name: Substitute-market STR prices (Summit County, Vail, Steamboat 5+BR)
mechanism: Price-per-quality vs substitutes predicts share loss (substitution index)
prior_evidence: repo WP-11 design
value_tier: B: needs comp reliability first

name: Utah, Tahoe, Montana snowpack (fly-in substitutes)
mechanism: Fly-in skiers choose among regions; Utah drought vs Colorado snow shifts fly-in share
prior_evidence: DestiMetrics 2026: Colorado and Utah both struggled; 'rest of West' did better (saminfo)
value_tier: B: cheap; fly-in only

name: I-70 vs US-40 segment-specific congestion and closures (substitution only west of Empire)
mechanism: I-70 events WEST of Empire (Georgetown, Eisenhower Tunnel, Vail Pass) block Summit/Vail but not Winter Park, so they favour us; events EAST of Empire (Floyd Hill, Idaho Springs, exits 241-247) are SHARED and hurt us too. A flag must use route + milepost from the CARS feed
prior_evidence: I-70 Coalition (STALE) on congestion avoidance
value_tier: B: unique edge but effect UNVERIFIED and few events per season; depends on fixing A01

name: Outbound alternatives: Mexico beach / Caribbean airfares and advisories at Christmas and spring break
mechanism: Warm-weather trips compete for the same holiday week for affluent families
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

name: Comp reviews, ratings and review counts
mechanism: Ratings shift choice share; review velocity is a booking-volume proxy for comps (reviews follow stays)
data_quality_risk: selection bias in reviews; Inside Airbnb default is 3 nights per booking (or minimum nights if higher) where no city figure is published, while our homes' requests average about 8 nights (dossier 02), so default occupancy conversion would be badly off for large homes
prior_evidence: Inside Airbnb San Francisco model: 50% review rate x average stay converts reviews to occupancy (insideairbnb.com/data-assumptions)
value_tier: B: comp-quality adjustment for anchors

name: Search rank of our listings for Winter Park 14+ guest searches
mechanism: Rank drops reduce views; price changes affect rank
prior_evidence: none public
value_tier: B: direct read of visibility; price is a ranking input

name: Guest Favorite / Superhost / Premier Host status
mechanism: Badges raise conversion; losing them warrants caution on price increases
prior_evidence: none independent
value_tier: C

name: Listing photo/amenity quality of comps (hot tub, ski-in, bedrooms, sleeps)
mechanism: Hedonic attributes adjust comp prices to our homes
prior_evidence: hedonic STR pricing literature (Wang & Nicolau 2017 IJHM 62:120-131)
value_tier: B: improves anchors

name: Avalanche/road closure events log (Berthoud, I-70, Loveland) as history
mechanism: Event history to fit closure hazard by storm type; guides cancellation policy
prior_evidence: codot.gov Jan 2024 Berthoud closure
value_tier: C

name: Rocky Mountain National Park (Grand Lake entrance) timed-entry and visitation
mechanism: Summer demand driver for Grand County; timed-entry rules can divert visitors
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C: summer is ~30% of revenue

name: Local disease/health events (norovirus, COVID waves) and CDC wastewater
mechanism: Health waves deter travel and cause cancellations
prior_evidence: none current
value_tier: C

name: Own cancellation and modification flow by lead time
mechanism: Cancellations after storms or closures release inventory; hazard by lead time sets overbooking and re-price triggers
prior_evidence: Dossier 02: 13 cancellations, too few to fit
value_tier: A: needed for correct pace (input to A-tier L01); tiny n means it starts from a literature prior plus market data

name: Google Maps Popular Times / place busyness for Winter Park village
mechanism: Coincident crowd measure
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

name: Phone-location visitation panels (Placer.ai, Near) for Winter Park base
mechanism: Visitor counts by origin and dwell time; calibrates segments
prior_evidence: UO thesis on Vail turnout used phone data (details UNVERIFIED); dossier 01 advises not to buy

name: Snow-chasing app downloads/usage (OnTheSnow, OpenSnow app ranks)
mechanism: Interest proxy at storm onset
prior_evidence: none
value_tier: C

mechanism: Not for nightly pricing; informs owner multi-year rate strategy
prior_evidence: Parthum & Christensen 2022 project -40 to -60% snow-related revenue by 2100 (high emissions)
value_tier: C

name: I-70 Floyd Hill project planned closures (Idaho Springs to US 6, exits 241-247, shared Denver-Empire segment)
mechanism: Planned overnight full closures on the segment Winter Park traffic shares with Summit traffic add friction on known dates; CDOT says overnight EB/WB closures mid-November to mid-December 2026
access: manual/RSS; also in CARS roadWork layer
prior_evidence: CDOT notice 2026-10-12 (FETCHED): EB closure Oct 18-19, WB Oct 19 and 20; more mid-Nov to mid-Dec
value_tier: C: dated and free, but overnight closures barely touch arrivals

name: Lighthouse Market Insight forward demand (and search-demand data, UNVERIFIED)
mechanism: Forward-looking market demand indicators for a destination; if it includes search volume it is a licensable intent signal
access: paid (API listing exists per reviewer; UNVERIFIED)
data_quality_risk: hotel-centric; STR coverage for Grand County unknown
prior_evidence: ShortTermRentalz 2023-11-09: Market Insight is forward-looking demand monitoring; search-volume content UNVERIFIED
value_tier: C: unverified content and coverage; evaluate if L07 trial fails

name: FTC Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees (total-price display for short-term lodging)
mechanism: Since 2025-05-12 vacation rentals must show a total price including mandatory cleaning fees (taxes may be excluded but disclosed); guests compare all-in prices, so comp anchors and our elasticity must be all-in
prior_evidence: FTC FAQ (FETCHED 2026-10-17): covers home shares and vacation rentals on Airbnb/VRBO; cleaning fee must be in total price
value_tier: B: defines the price variable every comp and elasticity estimate must use

name: Airbnb fee structure change (15.5% host-only fee for PMS-connected hosts)
mechanism: Moving from about 3% host / 14-16% guest split to a 15.5% host-only fee (reported effective 2025-10-27 for PMS-connected hosts) changes owner-net per displayed dollar and the mapping from listed to guest-paid price
data_quality_risk: dates conflict across vendor sources (Oct 27 vs Apr 13, 2025); Airbnb help page not checked
prior_evidence: PMS-vendor blogs (Hometime, Truvi, Rentals United; vendors, secondhand)
value_tier: B: directly changes owner-net per booking; must be in the fee model

name: Local STR tax ballot measures and rate changes (Winter Park, Fraser, Grand County; peer towns)
mechanism: Voter-approved STR lodging-tax increases raise guest all-in price or owner cost; peer-town votes (e.g. a reported narrow Vail rejection in Nov 2025, UNVERIFIED) signal regional direction
prior_evidence: Winter Park lodging tax 1% -> 3% July 2024 (Sky-Hi News)
value_tier: C

name: Resort capital projects (lifts, terrain, snowmaking) - USFS 'Winter Park Resort Projects 2025' (PALS 66200)
provider: USDA Forest Service Sulphur Ranger District
mechanism: New lifts, trails and snowmaking raise season-level quality and early-season reliability; status 'Developing Proposal', no decision yet (page updated 2026-05-28)
prior_evidence: USFS project page (FETCHED 2026-10-17): lift replacements/additions, snowmaking, Vasquez Ridge restaurant; EA expected; no gondola mentioned
